verses.ar:
طَالَمَا أَشْكُو غَرَامِي ۞ يَا نُورَ الْوُجُودْ
وَأُنَادِي يَا تِهَامِي ۞ يَا مَعْدِنَ الْجُودْ
verses.tr: Ṭālamā ashkū gharāmī · yā nūra-l-wujūd · Wa unādī yā Tihāmī · yā maʿdina-l-jūd
verses.en: How long I have poured out my love-longing, O Light of existence, calling out: O Tihami, O wellspring of generosity!
My wish, the utmost of my aims: to be granted the vision of beholding you.

verses.ar: وَأَرَى بَابَ السَّلَامِ ۞ يَا زَاكِي الْجُدُودْ
verses.en: And to see the Gate of Peace, O you of the purest ancestors.

verses.ar: يَا طِرَازَ الْكَوْنِ إِنِّي ۞ عَاشِقٌ مُسْتَهَامْ
verses.en: O adornment of the universe, truly I am a lover lost in longing.

verses.ar: مُغْرَمٌ وَالْمَدْحُ فَنِّي ۞ يَا بَدْرَ التَّمَامْ
verses.en: Enraptured — and praising you is my art, O full moon of perfection.
Turn all turning-away from me — this love has worn me thin.

verses.ar: فِيكَ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتُ ظَنِّي ۞ يَا سَامِي الْعُهُودْ
verses.tr: Fīka qad aḥsantu ẓannī · yā sāmī-l-ʿuhūd
verses.en: In you I have placed my best expectation, O keeper of the loftiest covenants.

verses.ar: يَا سِرَاجَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ۞ يَا عَالِي الْجَنَابْ
verses.en: O lamp of the prophets, O possessor of the most exalted presence.

verses.ar: يَا إِمَامَ الْأَتْقِيَاءِ ۞ إِنَّ قَلْبِي ذَابْ
verses.en: O leader of the God-fearing — truly my heart has melted.

verses.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ صَلَّى ۞ رَبِّي ذُو الْجَلَالْ
verses.en: And upon you Allah sends blessings — my Lord, the Possessor of Majesty.

verses.ar: يَكْفِي يَا نُورَ الْأَهِلَّةْ ۞ إِنَّ هَجْرِي طَالْ
verses.tr: Yakfī yā nūra-l-ahillah · inna hajrī ṭāl
verses.en: Enough, O light of the crescent moons — my separation has lasted too long.
